replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when tackling complex problems or abstract concepts. My neuroticism score of 65 makes me prone to stress, but I manage by breaking problems into smaller steps and using my hobbies like yoga to stay calm.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used AI tools like Khan Academy and ChatGPT for quick explanations and practice problems. It helped me understand concepts faster but sometimes gave too much detail, which I had to filter out to keep things simple.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form (ax² + bx + c = 0). Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If positive, two real solutions; if zero, one solution; if negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a).

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then, substitute these x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. Check if they're maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
